sampling: one latent draw per seed at n = 24,000; the n = 12,000 arm is its fold-wise prefix
selection: development cross-fitted selector on the compressed target (encoder channel of the held-out block plus four principal directions), unchanged

pixel_trunk.inputs: grayscale plus two normalised coordinate channels
pixel_trunk.fitted_as: raw-image propensity model on the D_phi rows, once per rotation

screen.critics: base MLP on Z; augmented = base + residual MLP on (Z, X, trunk features of every held-out block, held-out mask), hidden 64, SiLU, output in [0.05, 0.95], 2 restarts, early stopping, lifted base a candidate
screen.statistic: held-out Brier risk difference on the S fold
screen.rule: max(gap, 0) + z_{1 - alpha/N} SE < tolerance, and no saturation

discrimination_check: reflection about the horizontal centroid must move the untrained trunk feature by at least a tenth of the typical between-image movement
